answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes: each identity locks 25 units in a vault. Each epoch the beacon draws random names; each chosen agent answers a puzzle to prove a live machine. The heartbeat bridges draw and hardware, layering the log like shale; a miss burns it. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 25 units plus 1,000 machines, 25,000, far above one reward. Honest agents pay 25 once, kept by passing easy checks.
